content.text: Found it — the app is installed on the Pixel 8 Pro (serial `<REDACTED-1>`). I'll use that device for all measurements.
First run recorded: **3691 ms**. Now I'll repeat the close→open cycle 4 more times for a total of 5 cold-start measurements.

## Cold-Start Results — BenchTarget (`dev.lincforge.benchtarget`) on Pixel 8 Pro

Each run: force-stopped the app (`close`) to guarantee the process was fully killed, then launched it (`open`) and measured the round-trip duration reported by the launch command.

| Run | Cold-start time (ms) |
|-----|----------------------|
| 1   | 3691 |
| 2   | 2819 |
| 3   | 3706 |
| 4   | 3072 |
| 5   | 3285 |

**Median:** 3285 ms
**Mean:** 3314.6 ms
**Sample standard deviation:** ≈ 387.4 ms (sample variance ≈ 150,055 ms²)
**Population standard deviation:** ≈ 346.5 ms (population variance ≈ 120,044 ms²)

Note: the device is connected to a fleet with 4 Android targets (Pixel Watch 2, Pixel 8 Pro, SM G970U, SM T570) — BenchTarget was only installed on the **Pixel 8 Pro** (serial `<REDACTED-1>`), so all measurements were taken there. The timing is the tool's `open-command-roundtrip` duration (time from issuing the launch to the app being detected foregrounded), which includes a small amount of command-dispatch overhead on top of pure ActivityManager launch time.
